query:
SELECT id, name, cas_number, formula, family, chemical_class, smiles, status,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(notes,'')) as notes_len,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plant_molecules pm WHERE pm.molecule_id = m.id) as plant_links
FROM molecules m
WHERE id IN (1710025, 1720014, 1710027, 1720012)
ORDER BY id;
